retrievalProfile.description: A dark, moody composition featuring low-key profile portraits emerging from deep shadows, paired with ornate, interlocking swash typography in vibrant mid-century colors.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist sans-serif typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: Four male figures in profile or three-quarter view are positioned in the lower half of a square frame, their features partially obscured by heavy shadows. The upper half is dominated by a dark, textured background featuring a complex, multi-colored typographic lockup with extended swashes and interlocking characters.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between deep black negative space and illuminated facial features
Horizontal alignment of portraits along the bottom third
Asymmetrical typographic cluster in the upper left quadrant
Color coordination between clothing and typography
coreInvariants: Deep black background with visible grain/texture
Low-key lighting with strong rim light on profiles
Interlocking swash characters in the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portraits are small-scale, arranged horizontally across the bottom 40% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, ornate ampersand or central swash character in the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the colorful typography in the top left, moves down to the faces, and scans horizontally across the profiles.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black space in the upper right and center, creating a sense of depth and mystery.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Olive Green and Sky Blue (Typography and Clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights on faces and high-chroma accents in the text.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary reds or yellows
Limit to muted earth tones and cool blues

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke weight with high contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is oversized and ornate with circular loops
Initial capitals feature elongated, sweeping tails
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix of script-like display serifs with smaller, wider sans-serif metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 60s/70s decorative serif feel with extended tails.
Provides the appropriate vintage weight and curve style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, textured black background with four men in profile view along the bottom, lit with low-key rim lighting in olive green sweaters.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add decorative swash typography in the upper left, using olive green and sky blue, ensuring letters overlap and interlock.

verificationChecks: Portraits must be low-key and profile-oriented
Colors must be muted olive and blue

avoid: Flat, solid black backgrounds without texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the ampersand or central character is the focal point of the text
Check that the faces are emerging from shadow, not fully lit
Verify the 'plastic wrap' or vintage vinyl texture is present
Confirm the color palette is limited to the specified vintage tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine low-key profile photography with 1960s swash-heavy display type in a dark, textured square format.
